33210dc docs: add critical GitHub status production deployment troubleshooting [90m(21/01/2026)[0m
  Extended the init guide with comprehensive troubleshooting for the
  common production issue where GitHub statuses show as empty in the
  feature-request page.
  
  Changes to docs/init-github-projects-workflow.md:
  - Added new "GitHub Status Integration Issues" section in Troubleshooting
  - Enhanced Step 5 with critical warnings about required GitHub env vars
  - Added verification steps to confirm all 5 GitHub variables are set
  - Included detailed fix instructions using vercel-cli
  
  This addresses the production integration issue where:
  - GitHub workflows work locally but not in production
  - Feature-request page shows empty GitHub statuses
  - Missing GITHUB_OWNER, GITHUB_REPO, GITHUB_PROJECT_NUMBER, or
    GITHUB_OWNER_TYPE environment variables in Vercel
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3ad3d23 docs: add critical production deployment notes for GitHub integration [90m(21/01/2026)[0m

106bae4 fix: agents and scripts now load .env.local files [90m(20/01/2026)[0m
  All agent scripts (product-design, tech-design, implement, auto-advance)
  and utility scripts (github-pr, telegram-*, vercel-cli, mark-issue-done)
  now properly load environment variables from both .env and .env.local
  files, with .env.local taking priority.
  
  Created shared loadEnv utility that follows Next.js convention:
  - Loads .env first (base config)
  - Loads .env.local second (overrides with local secrets)
  
  This fixes the "Missing required environment variable" errors that
  occurred when GitHub Projects variables existed only in .env.local.
  
  Changes:
  - Created src/agents/shared/loadEnv.ts utility
  - Updated src/agents/shared/index.ts to import loadEnv
  - Replaced 'dotenv/config' with loadEnv in 4 agent files
  - Replaced 'dotenv/config' with loadEnv in 6 script files
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

02e0155 docs: add critical yarn checks requirements [90m(20/01/2026)[0m
  CLAUDE.md:
  - Add new "Validation & Quality Checks" section before Guidelines Compliance
  - CRITICAL requirement for Claude Code planning mode: always include yarn checks as final task
  - Emphasize running yarn checks before commits, PRs, syncs, and deploys
  - Clear expected output and error handling workflow
  
  .claude/commands/sync-children.md:
  - Add "CRITICAL: Run Yarn Checks First" section at top
  - Explain why running yarn checks before sync is critical:
    - Prevents breaking changes from propagating to all children
    - Saves time by fixing template once instead of in every child
    - Maintains quality standards
    - Avoids cascading failures
  - Add Step 0: Validate Template (REQUIRED) in Process section
  - Clear workflow: validate template → only then sync children
  
  Rationale:
  Previous sync-children runs propagated TypeScript errors to all child projects,
  requiring manual fixes in each project. This adds mandatory validation step to
  prevent broken code from being synced.
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
